The scientist has traveled extensively in Asia.
這位科學家曾在亞洲各地廣泛旅行。
This topic has been extensively discussed in the media.
這個話題在媒體上已被廣泛討論過。
She read extensively before writing her report.
她在寫報告前廣泛閱讀了大量資料。

whitehall.zh: 白廳（倫敦街道；英國政府的代稱）
ai: Whitehall is a street in London that has many government offices.
白廳是倫敦的一條街，上面有許多政府機關。
People often use Whitehall to mean the British civil service.
人們常用「白廳」來指稱英國的文官體系。
We walked along Whitehall on our way to Parliament Square.
我們沿著白廳走向國會廣場。
Cows roam freely on the hills here.
這裡的牛群在山丘上自由漫步。
We roamed through the old streets without a map.
我們沒帶地圖，在老街裡到處閒逛。
Young people like to roam the city at night.
年輕人喜歡在夜裡到城市各處閒逛。
The firefighter made a heroic effort to save the child.
那位消防員奮力英勇地救出孩子。
The town praised the heroic act of the young swimmer.
小鎮稱讚那位年輕游泳者的英勇行為。
It was a heroic decision to stay and help others.
留下來幫助別人是個英勇的決定。
The waves left white foam on the sand.
海浪在沙灘上留下白色的泡沫。
I like a lot of foam on my coffee.
我喜歡咖啡上有很多奶泡。
Soap foam covered the surface of the sink.
肥皂泡沫覆蓋了水槽的表面。
The soda began to foam when I opened it.
我打開汽水時，它開始冒泡。
Shampoo will foam more in warm water.
洗髮精遇到溫水會起更多泡沫。
People born in late July or August are Leo.
在七月底或八月出生的人是獅子座。
She read in a magazine that Leo is a bold sign.
她在雜誌上讀到獅子座是個大膽的星座。
The Latin word Leo means lion.
拉丁文的 Leo 意思是獅子。
Please write your name and affiliation on the form.
請在表格上寫下你的姓名和所屬單位。
The speaker's affiliation was a well-known university.
這位講者隸屬於一所知名的大學。
The group has no political affiliation.
這個團體沒有隸屬於任何政黨。
Her religious affiliation does not affect her work.
她的宗教歸屬不影響她的工作。
Voters were asked about their party affiliation.
選民被問到他們所屬的政黨。
An asteroid is a small rocky object that moves around the sun.
小行星是繞著太陽運行的小型岩石天體。
Scientists track each asteroid that comes near the Earth.
科學家追蹤每一顆接近地球的小行星。
The movie is about an asteroid heading toward the planet.
這部電影是關於一顆朝地球飛來的小行星。
The course has a clear and structured plan.
這門課有清楚而有組織的計畫。
She prefers a structured day with a fixed schedule.
她喜歡行程固定、有條理的一天。
A well structured essay is easier to read.
結構完整的文章比較好讀。
The children found an abandoned house at the edge of the village.
孩子們在村子邊緣發現了一棟廢棄的房子。
An abandoned dog was waiting beside the road.
一隻被遺棄的狗在路邊等著。
The factory has been abandoned for ten years.
這間工廠已經廢棄十年了。

abandoned.zh: 拋棄；放棄（abandon 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: They abandoned the plan because it cost too much.
他們因為花費太高而放棄了這個計畫。
The crew abandoned the ship as it began to sink.
船開始下沉時，船員們棄船而去。
The restaurant thanks its customers for their patronage.
餐廳感謝顧客的光顧。
The museum depends on the patronage of local businesses.
這間博物館仰賴當地企業的贊助。
Artists once relied on the patronage of rich families.
藝術家們過去仰賴富裕家族的資助。

frustrating.zh: 令人沮喪的；令人挫折的
ai: It is frustrating to wait for a bus that never comes.
等一輛一直不來的公車讓人很沮喪。
The slow internet was frustrating during the online meeting.
線上會議時網路很慢，真令人火大。
She found the puzzle frustrating at first.
一開始她覺得這個謎題很令人挫折。
He hastily packed his bag and ran to the station.
他匆忙地收拾背包，跑向車站。
The letter was hastily written and full of mistakes.
這封信寫得很倉促，錯誤百出。
She hastily closed the door when she heard a noise.
她聽到聲音後匆忙把門關上。
Honesty is the best policy in any friendship.
在任何友誼中，誠實都是最好的做法。
I admire her honesty when she admits a mistake.
我很欣賞她承認錯誤時的誠實。
The teacher praised the boy for his honesty.
老師稱讚那個男孩的誠實。
The apple was fresh and crisp.
這顆蘋果新鮮又清脆。
I love the crisp skin of roast chicken.
我愛烤雞酥脆的外皮。
Fry the potatoes until they are golden and crisp.
把馬鈴薯炸到金黃酥脆。
It was a crisp autumn morning with clear skies.
那是個空氣清爽、天空晴朗的秋天早晨。
We enjoyed a walk in the crisp air.
我們在清爽的空氣中散步。
He ate a packet of crisps while watching the match.
他邊看比賽邊吃了一包洋芋片。
Children often take crisps in their lunch boxes.
孩子們常會在便當盒裡放洋芋片。
It is unlawful to drive without a license.
沒有駕照開車是非法的。
The court said the company's action was unlawful.
法院表示該公司的行為違法。
The man was stopped for unlawful parking.
那名男子因違法停車而被攔下。
Sutton is the name of several towns in England.
薩頓是英格蘭好幾個城鎮的名稱。
The train to Sutton leaves from London every hour.
開往薩頓的火車每小時從倫敦出發。
Sutton is a borough in the south of London.
薩頓是倫敦南部的一個行政區。
She does ten minutes of meditation every morning.
她每天早上做十分鐘的冥想。
Meditation helps me feel calm after a busy day.
冥想幫助我在忙碌一天後感到平靜。
He sat in quiet meditation by the lake.
他在湖邊靜靜地沉思。
The police are looking for the attacker.
警方正在尋找那名攻擊者。
The goalkeeper stopped the attacker's shot.
守門員擋下了攻擊者的射門。
The victim could not see the face of her attacker.
受害者沒有看清攻擊她的人的臉。
She was fearful of walking alone at night.
她害怕夜裡獨自走路。
The dog became fearful when the thunder started.
打雷時，那隻狗變得很害怕。
Many people are fearful about losing their jobs.
許多人擔心會失去工作。
A fearful storm shook the little boat.
一場可怕的暴風雨搖晃著那艘小船。
The fearful noise woke everyone in the house.
那陣可怕的聲響吵醒了屋裡的每一個人。
The court may overturn the earlier decision.
法院可能會推翻先前的判決。
The new rule was overturned after many complaints.
在許多人抱怨後，這項新規定被撤銷了。
A strong wave overturned the small boat.
一陣大浪使那艘小船翻覆了。
The truck overturned on the icy road.
卡車在結冰的路面上翻覆。
Be careful not to overturn the vase.
小心別把花瓶打翻了。
The child tugged at his mother's sleeve.
孩子用力拉扯媽媽的袖子。
She tugged the heavy bag across the floor.
她把沉重的袋子在地板上拖著走。
He tugged the rope until the boat came closer.
他用力拉繩子，直到船靠近。
I felt a tug on my fishing line.
我感覺釣線被用力扯了一下。
Give the door a hard tug if it sticks.
如果門卡住了，就用力拉一下。
We had grilled lobster at a restaurant by the sea.
我們在海邊的餐廳吃了烤龍蝦。
A lobster has two big claws.
龍蝦有兩隻大螯。
The fisherman caught several lobsters in his traps.
漁夫在籠子裡抓到了好幾隻龍蝦。
Take the second turning on the left.
在第二個路口左轉。
We missed the turning and had to drive back.
我們錯過了那個岔路口，只好開回去。
There is a turning just after the petrol station.
加油站後面不遠有一個岔路口。

turning.zh: 轉動；轉向；變成（turn 的現在分詞）
ai: She is turning the page of her book.
她正在翻書頁。
The leaves are turning red and yellow in autumn.
秋天時樹葉正轉成紅色和黃色。
He kept turning his head to look at the clock.
他不停轉頭去看時鐘。
Madrid is the capital of Spain.
馬德里是西班牙的首都。
We stayed three days in Madrid and visited many museums.
我們在馬德里待了三天，參觀了許多博物館。
Madrid is in the center of Spain.
馬德里位於西班牙的中部。
Plug the lamp into the mains and switch it on.
把燈接上市電，然後打開開關。
This radio works on batteries or on mains power.
這台收音機可以用電池或市電供電。
Turn off the mains before you change the wires.
更換電線前，要先關掉電源總開關。
A water mains pipe broke under the street.
街道底下的一條自來水幹管破裂了。
Workers repaired the gas mains over the weekend.
工人在週末修好了瓦斯幹線。
In the story, a dwarf lives deep inside a mountain.
故事裡有個矮人住在山的深處。
The dwarf in the fairy tale was good at making tools.
童話裡的矮人很會做工具。
The book describes a dwarf who guards a golden treasure.
這本書描寫了一位守護金色寶藏的矮人。
The tall tower dwarfs every other building in the city.
這座高塔讓城裡所有其他建築都相形見絀。
Her success dwarfed all of our earlier results.
她的成功讓我們先前所有的成績都顯得微不足道。
The hospital has a specialised team for heart surgery.
這間醫院有專門負責心臟手術的團隊。
You need specialised tools to fix this machine.
你需要專用的工具來修理這台機器。
She works in a highly specialised field of science.
她從事的是一個高度專門化的科學領域。
They built a lasting friendship during university.
他們在大學期間建立了長久的友誼。
The festival made a lasting impression on me.
這個節慶給我留下了持久的印象。
We hope for a lasting peace in the region.
我們希望這個地區能有長久的和平。
Please read the preceding chapter before the class.
上課前請先讀前一章。
Sales rose in the preceding year.
前一年的銷售額上升了。
The preceding paragraph explains the main idea.
前面那段說明了主要的想法。

freeman.zh: 自由民；享有公民權的人
ai: In the old town, a freeman had the right to trade freely.
在古老的城鎮裡，自由民有自由經商的權利。
The city gave the honor of freeman to the famous writer.
這座城市把榮譽市民的稱號授予那位著名作家。
Only a freeman could vote in the medieval council.
在中世紀的議會裡，只有自由民才能投票。
The debate became partisan and nobody listened.
辯論變得充滿黨派色彩，沒有人願意聽別人說話。
A partisan crowd cheered for the home team.
一群偏袒的觀眾為主場球隊加油。
Judges must not be partisan in their decisions.
法官在判決時不得偏袒任何一方。
A partisan hid in the forest during the war.
戰爭期間，一名游擊隊員藏身在森林裡。
He is a loyal partisan of the local football club.
他是當地足球俱樂部的忠實擁護者。
The phone has an enhanced camera for taking night photos.
這支手機有個加強版的相機，可以拍夜景。
The software offers enhanced security for users.
這套軟體為使用者提供加強的安全性。
An enhanced version of the game will be released soon.
這款遊戲的強化版很快就會推出。
The region has abundant rain and fertile soil.
這個地區雨量充沛、土壤肥沃。
Fresh fruit is abundant in the summer market.
夏季的市場上新鮮水果很充足。
The lake has abundant fish for the local people.
這座湖為當地人提供了豐富的魚。
He used a long hose to water the garden.
他用一條長水管幫花園澆水。
The firefighters connected the hose to a hydrant.
消防員把水管接到消防栓上。
Don't forget to roll up the hose after you use it.
用完後別忘了把水管捲起來。
She hosed the dirt off the car.
她用水管把車上的髒污沖掉。
We hose down the patio every weekend.
我們每個週末都用水管沖洗露台。
The company is aggressively expanding into new markets.
這家公司正積極擴展到新的市場。
She aggressively pursued her goal of becoming a doctor.
她積極追求成為醫生的目標。

aggressively.zh: 咄咄逼人地；有攻擊性地
ai: The dog barked aggressively at the stranger.
那隻狗對陌生人凶猛地吠叫。
He spoke aggressively and made everyone uncomfortable.
他說話咄咄逼人，讓大家都很不自在。
